_comment: Matter-side salesperson → client-code mapping. Overrides the LIS User Client Mapping for the Tracer's Sales chips only; the LIS itself is untouched. `id` matching a LIS Sales & Marketing user id replaces that user's code list; any other id adds a salesperson the LIS does not have (keep the `mx-` prefix so it can never collide with a LIS id). Codes are bare MCC client codes; at run time each is widened to every LIS master spelling that starts with it, like the Regions file. Edit and save — re-read on every request, bind-mounted read-only into the app container.
